name: pi-deepseek-cache
description: DeepSeek cache optimization: prefix cache alignment to reduce repeated token cost and first-token latency.

piwin.patchNotes: 1: drop the composer hit-rate status chip; 2: split persistence/overlays modules; 3: recognize vendor-prefixed DeepSeek ids and summarize with the active model when flash is absent; 4: replace the removed modelRegistry.listProviders() lookup; 5: pick the first signed-in summarizer and include split-turn prefix messages; 6: record the real summarizer model id; npmVersion corrected to 0.5.1 (the vendored source matches that release, 1.0.4 was never published)
